prologue.wa02: A man who returned alive from war.
prologue.wa04: But his home had burned to nothing.
prologue.wa06: Killu, once a neighbor and friend, had crushed his family.
prologue.wa08: His wife was taken as a servant and suffered unspeakable horrors,
prologue.wa09: until she could bear no more and took her own life.
prologue.wa11: His children were sold into slavery. No one knows where they are.
prologue.wa12: His elderly parents were imprisoned and starved to death.
prologue.wa14: Everyone in the Killu household knew.
prologue.wa15: Thirty-one of them saw everything and looked away.
prologue.wa17: That night, he killed the entire Killu family.
prologue.wa19: He cut off Killu's limbs with a blade,
prologue.wa20: even cauterized the wounds with fire to stop the bleeding,
prologue.wa21: and kept him alive for a long, long time.
prologue.wa24: And so he fell into hell.
prologue.wa26: "...This is but one tale among countless avengers."
prologue.wa28: "Every day, new souls fall into hell's labyrinth."
prologue.wa29: "Those consumed by rage, driven mad by injustice, those who lost love..."

intro.3: I was quite taken with that thrilling revenge of yours. A masterpiece.
intro.5:
Even after all the blood you have spilled, goodness still lingers within you.
You have not forgotten whom you must save… have you?
They are still waiting for you.
Make haste. Before it is too late.
intro.8: So the sight of that child's rocking horse brings even a dead man to his senses.
intro.10:
Very well. Escape this place. I will personally help you.
Diroy and Hector will guide you.
intro.11: Don't be alarmed. Let's introduce ourselves. I'm Diroy.
intro.12:
I'm Hector. Think of us as a blessing from the goddess.
We need to get out of here too.
intro.13:
Demons are beings made of malice.
They instinctively attack goodness.
intro.14:
But you're different. Your goodness is strong.
Your malice has only erupted for a while. That outburst will fade soon.
intro.15: So demons will catch your scent and come swarming toward you.
intro.16: The goddess has granted you armaments. Take them.
intro.17:
A projection sent by the goddess. A soul from the battlefield.
It will dwell in the crossbow and fight alongside you.
intro.21: This human passed out again. How long has he gone without sleep?
intro.22: Looks like he spent days without food or sleep, thinking of nothing but revenge.
intro.23: We need to wake him, even if we have to feed him malice.
intro.10c: Until we meet again, dead one.
intro.18b:
Put on that malice band too. It will steady your mind
before the unleashed malice drives you mad.
intro.22b: Leave him like this and he'll be eaten.
